title: Patch 1.3.1.1
text: Released on 31/10/24 Some event messages that were in Korean have been translated back to English The Pure Ice Packs tradepack can be stored again Serendipity Stones will no longer be titled "Bound Serendipity Stone" The Infused Emerald for the Emerald Hasla weapons will now be bound Hellkissed Evenstones should now allow for the destruction of the Hellkissed weapons again Flame Endless Arrows should now work correctly with Serpent's Sight The values of Sunken Treasure have been adjusted The chests from the Castaway Treasure Chests event will be spawning! They count as RELIC PACKS and must be turned in to any RELIC trader! The Mysterious Crates found in Auroria have been fixed and its value increased to 500 gold per pack The Salvage Forges will no longer offer converting back into TSTs The changes to Saplings, Seeds and Livestock prices have been restored back to their pre-1.3 values. Farmers rejoice! Some union busting work has been done to make gold traders from 3.0 get back to work Fixed vehicle upgrade tickets being convertible and their crafting recipes. Fixed the category for Seastorm Prototype craft Hallowtide crafting recipes have all been changed to a single token. Existing tokens will convert to a primary token to be used for the entire event. Fixed localization errors with regrade charms Updated "The Spirit of Halloween" to be a daily quest. More Jack-o-snacks for everyone!
html:
Released on 31/10/24

  • Some event messages that were in Korean have been translated back to English
  • The Pure Ice Packs tradepack can be stored again
  • Serendipity Stones will no longer be titled "Bound Serendipity Stone"
  • The Infused Emerald for the Emerald Hasla weapons will now be bound
  • Hellkissed Evenstones should now allow for the destruction of the Hellkissed weapons again
  • Flame Endless Arrows should now work correctly with Serpent's Sight
  • The values of Sunken Treasure have been adjusted
  • The chests from the Castaway Treasure Chests event will be spawning! They count as RELIC PACKS and must be turned in to any RELIC trader!
  • The Mysterious Crates found in Auroria have been fixed and its value increased to 500 gold per pack
  • The Salvage Forges will no longer offer converting back into TSTs
  • The changes to Saplings, Seeds and Livestock prices have been restored back to their pre-1.3 values. Farmers rejoice!
  • Some union busting work has been done to make gold traders from 3.0 get back to work
  • Fixed vehicle upgrade tickets being convertible and their crafting recipes.
  • Fixed the category for Seastorm Prototype craft
  • Hallowtide crafting recipes have all been changed to a single token. Existing tokens will convert to a primary token to be used for the entire event.
  • Fixed localization errors with regrade charms
  • Updated "The Spirit of Halloween" to be a daily quest. More Jack-o-snacks for everyone!
wikitext:
Released on 31/10/24

* Some event messages that were in Korean have been translated back to English
* The Pure Ice Packs tradepack can be stored again
* Serendipity Stones will no longer be titled "Bound Serendipity Stone"
* The Infused Emerald for the Emerald Hasla weapons will now be bound
* Hellkissed Evenstones should now allow for the destruction of the Hellkissed weapons again
* Flame Endless Arrows should now work correctly with Serpent's Sight
* The values of Sunken Treasure have been adjusted
* The chests from the Castaway Treasure Chests event will be spawning! They count as RELIC PACKS and must be turned in to any RELIC trader!
* The Mysterious Crates found in Auroria have been fixed and its value increased to 500 gold per pack
* The Salvage Forges will no longer offer converting back into TSTs
* The changes to Saplings, Seeds and Livestock prices have been restored back to their pre-1.3 values. Farmers rejoice!
* Some union busting work has been done to make gold traders from 3.0 get back to work
* Fixed vehicle upgrade tickets being convertible and their crafting recipes.
* Fixed the category for Seastorm Prototype craft
* Hallowtide crafting recipes have all been changed to a single token. Existing tokens will convert to a primary token to be used for the entire event.
* Fixed localization errors with regrade charms
* Updated "The Spirit of Halloween" to be a daily quest. More Jack-o-snacks for everyone!
